name: The Sheet Metal Shop
old_description: Welcome to The Sheet Metal Shop, your trusted partner for precision sheet metal fabrication in Columbus, Ohio. We specialize in providing top-notch solutions for all your commercial and residential sheet metal needs with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.
about:
The Sheet Metal Shop operates from Columbus, Ohio, as a veteran- and family-owned fabrication business. The company does not disclose a founding year, but its principals describe decades of industry experience behind the operation.

The shop provides precision sheet metal fabrication across a range of processes: plasma cutting, welding (including artistic, industrial, architectural, and stainless steel), custom ductwork, exhaust systems, HVAC components, grease ducts, roof curbs, roof rails, security cages, and specialized fittings. Materials worked include stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and black iron. The facility holds an R-Stamp certification for pressure-vessel fabrication, though no facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers span construction, manufacturing, and HVAC sectors, serving both residential and commercial clients throughout Columbus and Central Ohio. Projects range from custom HVAC sheet metal and duct fabrication to architectural metal art and anti-theft equipment enclosures.

The company cites its R-Stamp certification, veteran-and-family ownership, decades of hands-on experience, and investment in state-of-the-art equipment as the factors that differentiate its custom solutions.
